title: Smart Feeder Missed-Meal Detection
dataSources: Pet tracker location/activity (`tractive:position`, `whistle:activity`), smart feeder events (`petfeeder:event`), litter-box usage (`litterrobot:cycle`), bird-feeder detections.
app: Pet GPS/activity trackers (Tractive/Fi/Whistle), smart feeders and litter boxes, bird feeders/cams, and plant sensors via vendor APIs and MQTT to HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=petfeeder:event
| stats latest(status) as last_status, max(_time) as last_feed by feeder
| eval hours_since=round((now()-last_feed)/3600,1)
| where last_status="failed" OR hours_since>14
| sort - hours_since
description: Confirms your automatic pet feeder actually dispensed each scheduled meal and alerts on a jam or a missed feeding.
value: A stuck feeder means a hungry pet while you are out; verifying each meal turns 'I hope it fed them' into certainty.
implementation: Forward feeder dispense events; schedule after each meal window and alert on failures or overdue feeds.
visualization: Table of feeders by last feed status and time.
grandmaExplanation: It makes sure the automatic feeder really fed your pet, and warns you if it jammed or missed a meal.
